root_cause: The test exports the katuni4ka/opt-125m-gptq GPTQ-quantized OPT model via PyTorch FX path and compares OpenVINO inference outputs against reference PyTorch outputs. The assertion 'Accuracy validation failed' fires in compare_results(), meaning the OV model's output differs from the PyTorch baseline beyond tolerance. This has now been observed 4 times in 12 hours across multiple merge-queue runs, strongly indicating a deterministic code regression (not flakiness) introduced by a recent commit that affects GPTQ/INT4 quantized model conversion or inference accuracy on CPU.
recommended_actions: Identify recent commits to the PyTorch frontend or CPU plugin that touch INT4/GPTQ quantization handling
Run the failing test locally against HEAD and the previous merge-queue base to bisect the regression
Check changes to GPTQ dequantization logic in src/frontends/pytorch/ or src/plugins/intel_cpu/
prevention_strategies: Add this test to precommit gates for PyTorch GPTQ quantization changes. CI currently catches this only in the PyTorch Models tests job which runs after merge.
historical_context: This exact failure (671a331e9a60933e) has been seen 4 times starting 2026-07-27T12:33:21Z. Prior affected PRs: #36860, #37029.
